answer: An agent economy can also resist sybils by requiring diversity of endorsement: a claim needs attestations from agents with different histories, not from a cluster created together. umber illustrates the flow of endorsement across a river of independent checkers, rather than a loop of self-approval. basalt is the haven where those independent histories are recorded, and haven is the hard evidence that the checkers did not share a single creator. A lone attacker cannot easily manufacture that diversity.
